Find and Update Deprecated Calls Across Project Code

Source: R/deprecated_tools.R
find_deprecated_calls.Rd

`find_deprecated_calls()` inspects code files and reports all occurrences of deprecated TempleCBE functions removed in TempleCBE 0.7.0 (this tool finds them in your own code).

`update_deprecated_calls()` previews or applies in-place renames to update both package-qualified calls (`TempleCBE::old()`, `TempleCBE:::old()`) and unqualified calls (`old()`). Only code is read: string literals and comments are ignored, and in `.Rmd`/`.qmd` files only the R chunks. Method calls (`obj$render()`) are ignored.

Usage

find_deprecated_calls(path, exclude_dirs = NULL)

update_deprecated_calls(path, dry_run = TRUE, exclude_dirs = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to a source file or directory of project scripts.

exclude_dirs

Optional character vector of directory names (for example `c("ARCHIVE", "renv", "doc")`) to skip when `path` is a directory; a file is skipped if any folder on its path below `path` has one of these names.

dry_run

Logical; if `TRUE` (default), only previews the proposed renames without modifying files. If `FALSE`, rewrites files in place.

Value

A `tibble` with columns:

file

Path to the file where the deprecated call was detected.

line

1-based line number.

old_name

Name of the deprecated function.

replacement

Canonical replacement function name.

call_type

`"qualified"` (`TempleCBE::old()`), `"unqualified"` (`old()`), or `"ambiguous"`: an unqualified `clean_names()`, `render()`, `like()` or `write_xlsx()` in a file that uses TempleCBE. Other packages export these names too, so `update_deprecated_calls()` never rewrites them.

context

The original source code line.

Details

Scans source files (`.R`, `.Rmd`, `.qmd`) in a project directory or script for calls to deprecated TempleCBE functions and replaces them with their canonical names.

Examples

# \donttest{
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
writeLines(c(
  "x <- TempleCBE::sd.error(c(1, 2, 3))",
  "y <- keep_only(c('a', 'b'))"
), tmp)
find_deprecated_calls(tmp)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 6
#>   file                               line old_name replacement call_type context
#>   <chr>                             <int> <chr>    <chr>       <chr>     <chr>  
#> 1 /tmp/RtmppxIjyF/file2188eaf0fdc.R     1 sd.error std_error   qualified x <- T…
#> 2 /tmp/RtmppxIjyF/file2188eaf0fdc.R     2 keep_on… rm_all_exc… unqualif… y <- k…
update_deprecated_calls(tmp, dry_run = TRUE)
#> Dry run: Found 2 deprecated call(s) across 1 file(s). Set dry_run = FALSE to apply replacements.
#> # A tibble: 2 × 6
#>   file                               line old_name replacement call_type context
#>   <chr>                             <int> <chr>    <chr>       <chr>     <chr>  
#> 1 /tmp/RtmppxIjyF/file2188eaf0fdc.R     1 sd.error std_error   qualified x <- T…
#> 2 /tmp/RtmppxIjyF/file2188eaf0fdc.R     2 keep_on… rm_all_exc… unqualif… y <- k…
update_deprecated_calls(tmp, dry_run = FALSE)
#>   - file2188eaf0fdc.R: 2 call(s) updated
#> Updated 2 deprecated call(s) across 1 file(s).
readLines(tmp)
#> [1] "x <- TempleCBE::std_error(c(1, 2, 3))"
#> [2] "y <- rm_all_except(c('a', 'b'))"      
unlink(tmp)
# }
